Raspberry Pi 5 Starter Kit

Our great-value Raspberry Pi 5 Starter Kit includes everything you need to begin using the latest generation of Raspberry Pi. This kit comes with the Raspberry Pi 5 board and essential accessories to help you get started quickly and easily.

It is perfect for beginners, students, and technology enthusiasts who want to explore programming, electronics, and computing. With this starter kit, you can set up your Raspberry Pi and start your projects right away without needing to purchase additional components.

Product Features

  • Latest generation Raspberry Pi 5 board
  • Powerful performance for programming, learning, and DIY projects
  • Beginner-friendly setup
  • Ideal for coding, electronics, and educational projects
  • Compact and energy-efficient mini computer
  • Supports multiple operating systems and applications

What’s Included in the Box

  • 1 × Raspberry Pi 5 Board
  • 1 × Power Supply
  • 1 × MicroSD Card 64gb
  • 1 × HDMI Cable
  • 1 × Protective Case
  • 1 × Cooling Fan or Heatsinks
name: Raspberry Pi 5  4gb Starter Kit
